lifecycle_shape.correction_receipt: Payload-free, exact-scope command receipt binding one affected authority record to one verified current replacement.
lifecycle_shape.selection: Only active prepared receipts in the exact workspace, owner, subject, audience and purpose that depend on the affected authority record are eligible.
lifecycle_shape.mutation: Eligible receipts gain invalidated_at and one payload-free invalidated event in the same transaction.
lifecycle_shape.replacement: The replacement may be a different row ID, which is required for append-only Brain item versioning.
lifecycle_shape.replay: Exact correction replay is idempotent; semantically identical concurrent identities converge; conflicting reuse of a correction ID fails closed.

negative_controls: removing the affected-record predicate makes the canary fail
removing the replacement-currentness guard makes the canary fail
changing the invalidation event type makes the canary fail

deliberate_exclusions.withdrawal_without_replacement: Closed because R12 has no independently verified withdrawal authority. A service command alone must not manufacture that fact.
deliberate_exclusions.automatic_regeneration: Invalidation prevents stale use. Creating a new prepared receipt remains a separate authority-checked operation.
deliberate_exclusions.erasure: Invalidation hides stale output but retains encrypted payload and audit metadata. Cryptographic erasure is the next separate gate.

remaining_gates: Add cryptographic erasure that removes ciphertext and encryption version while retaining content-free audit metadata.
Add a subject tombstone that prevents silent recreation after erasure without explicit new authority.
Prove correction and store races on a multi-connection PostgreSQL runtime.
Run candidates and tests through Supabase local plus PostgREST when Docker or Podman is available.
Review any migration and runtime caller separately before application.
bounded_claim: R12 proves one exact-scope, replacement-backed correction transaction on disposable PostgreSQL 18.3. It does not prove withdrawal, automatic regeneration, erasure, concurrent store-correction races, Supabase parity, migration or production readiness.
